published_content.origin: Editorial reading guides based on full-text primary papers; distinct from the raw AI-generated test drafts.

semiconductor_chip: qualitative SET / READ / RESET memory states
reaction_diffusion: conserved material and linked concentration plot

live_ai_validation.input: Original complete PDFs, 7 to 24 pages, downloaded from the NIH PMC open-access bucket with recorded SHA-256 checksums.

citation_correction.problem: A quote prefix found in a PDF was incorrectly classified as an exact match of the whole quoted sentence.
citation_correction.fix: Full matches remain exact. Prefix matches become approximate, and generated citation text retains only the matching prefix. Unlocated citations retain their uncertainty.

verification.browser: Chromium at 1440px and 375px, WebGL with SwiftShader and interactive 2D fallbacks; software rendering, not a physical GPU benchmark.

limits: The models teach selected mechanisms and explicitly state their scope; they do not reproduce the papers' measured device dimensions, kinetic parameters, yield or adsorption capacities.
The live pipeline test validates application behavior and source matching, not independent scientific confirmation of AI-generated claims.
Public reading guides link original papers; the source note is not presented as a local full-text PDF.
